addressing.not_addressable: an entity. Nothing routes from a person or an object to a bundle, so a caller holding an entity id has no address here and this bundle does not claim one

place.reason: this scene is bound to no place, which is the ordinary case for a scene

epistemics.evidence: original capture bytes, reached through /evidence/{span_id}. Nothing in this bundle is evidence
epistemics.geometry_is_derived: every geometry entry is a derivative of the photographs, produced by a reviewed stage bound to their exact bytes. It visualises what was observed; it does not support a claim
epistemics.physical_scale: unvalidated. Scene units are the recovered COLMAP frame, not metres, and no independent physical reference has been associated with these points

bundle.number_encoding: every measured number is a decimal string with exactly 12 fractional digits; canonical JSON admits no floats, because no two implementations agree on how to render one

region_graph.reason: no current structural snapshot exists in this workspace, so no region owns these photographs yet

release.blocked_until: separately authorized redistribution with authenticated authority and complete source-specific permission; this owning-workspace evidence contract does not grant it

permits: reading inside the owning workspace by an authenticated session
